V09's AP5b (l.4087) runs 'M-SF (with V08's SF4 and SF6; V08 §8.1)', but V08 §8.1 names no V09 step.
issues.required_change: V08 §8.1's list adds 'M3c (V10's C5 host seam and V09's AP8 card-only drawer, which SF6's host clerk and `ClerkMount.host` drive)' and 'V09's AP5b, the host shell verified on `embed.html` with SF4 and SF6'.

issues.claim: V08 §8.1 (l.3027-3028) says V11's C4 holds 'the rows items 111 and 113–118 read'. V11 §8's C4 (l.4680) holds only the SettlementForge vocabulary (`dossier.kinds`, archetypes, category synonyms, keywords, good words, ladders, the wall barrier and waterfront rows); the rows of items 111 and 113–119 are C9 (l.4685), priced at the milestones that build each item's base mechanism. So M-SF's dependency names the wrong V11 step.
issues.required_change: V08 §8.1: '… and V11's **C4** — the SettlementForge rows: `dossier.kinds`, archetypes, category synonyms, keywords, good words, ladders, the wall barrier and waterfront rows — and **C9**'s rows that items 111 and 113–118's port readings use (V11 §8, priced there, not here)'.
